s: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat «Amon»; and Amon begat Josias;

G395.d: a rising; the sun-rising, the east

G302.d: ever, soever; until; as soon as; Elliptical constructions; as it were

G393.d: trans., to cause to rise; Intrans., to rise

Saying, This fellow «persuadeth» men to worship God contrary to the law.

For I could wish that myself were «accursed» from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are «without» «excuse»:
Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and «renewing» of the Holy Ghost;
Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the «proportion» of faith;

G346.d: to sum up, gather up, present as a whole
s: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather «together» in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

And have put on the new man, which is «renewed» in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

And be «renewed» in the spirit of your mind;

s: Wherefore I «put» thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
